\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 261-264 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R269-first-pass-words-from-chapters-261-264}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a rolling pin and a sieve.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a maid, a gardener, a potter, a blacksmith, a goldsmith
  \item a carpenter, a cobbler, a priest, a piece of jewellery, a bangle
  \item an earring, a bindi, a bangle, an anklet, a flute
  \item a sitar, a tabla, a bell, a toy, a doll
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A maid? (\textbf{\hi{नौकरानी}}, \emph{naukarānī}.) A gardener? (\textbf{\hi{माली}}, \emph{mālī}.) A potter? (\textbf{\hi{कुम्हार}}, \emph{kumhār}.) A blacksmith? (\textbf{\hi{लोहार}}, \emph{lohār}.) A goldsmith? (\textbf{\hi{सुनार}}, \emph{sunār}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\hi{बढ़ई}}, \emph{baṛhaī}.) A cobbler? (\textbf{\hi{मोची}}, \emph{mochī}.) A priest? (\textbf{\hi{पुजारी}}, \emph{pujārī}.) A piece of jewellery? (\textbf{\hi{गहना}}, \emph{gahnā}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\hi{कंगन}}, \emph{kaṅgan}.) An earring? (\textbf{\hi{झुमका}}, \emph{jhumkā}.) A bindi? (\textbf{\hi{बिंदी}}, \emph{bindī}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\hi{चूड़ी}}, \emph{cūṛī}.) An anklet? (\textbf{\hi{पायल}}, \emph{pāyal}.) A flute? (\textbf{\hi{बाँसुरी}}, \emph{bā̃surī}.) A sitar? (\textbf{\hi{सितार}}, \emph{sitār}.) A tabla? (\textbf{\hi{तबला}}, \emph{tablā}.) A bell? (\textbf{\hi{घंटी}}, \emph{ghaṇṭī}.) A toy? (\textbf{\hi{खिलौना}}, \emph{khilaunā}.) A doll? (\textbf{\hi{गुड़िया}}, \emph{guṛiyā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 265-269 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R269-second-pass-words-from-chapters-265-269}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a kite and a swing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a kite, a swing, a curtain, a cotton rug, a carpet
  \item a latch, a saw, a pickaxe, a spade, a mattress
  \item a quilt, a mosquito net, a tap, a drain, a tank
  \item rubbish, a dustbin, smoke, fire, ash
  \item coal, gas, a wok, a rolling pin, a sieve
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A kite? (\textbf{\hi{पतंग}}, \emph{patang}.) A swing? (\textbf{\hi{झूला}}, \emph{jhūlā}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\hi{पर्दा}}, \emph{pardā}.) A cotton rug? (\textbf{\hi{दरी}}, \emph{darī}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\hi{क़ालीन}}, \emph{qālīn}.) A latch? (\textbf{\hi{चिटकनी}}, \emph{ciṭkanī}.) A saw? (\textbf{\hi{आरी}}, \emph{ārī}.) A pickaxe? (\textbf{\hi{कुदाल}}, \emph{kudāl}.) A spade? (\textbf{\hi{फावड़ा}}, \emph{phāvṛā}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\hi{गद्दा}}, \emph{gaddā}.) A quilt? (\textbf{\hi{रजाई}}, \emph{rajāī}.) A mosquito net? (\textbf{\hi{मच्छरदानी}}, \emph{maccharadānī}.) A tap? (\textbf{\hi{नल}}, \emph{nal}.) A drain? (\textbf{\hi{नाली}}, \emph{nālī}.) A tank? (\textbf{\hi{टंकी}}, \emph{ṭaṅkī}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\hi{कूड़ा}}, \emph{kūṛā}.) A dustbin? (\textbf{\hi{कूड़ेदान}}, \emph{kūṛedān}.) Smoke? (\textbf{\hi{धुआँ}}, \emph{dhuā̃}.) Fire? (\textbf{\hi{आग}}, \emph{āg}.) Ash? (\textbf{\hi{राख}}, \emph{rākh}.) Coal? (\textbf{\hi{कोयला}}, \emph{koylā}.) Gas? (\textbf{\hi{गैस}}, \emph{gais}.) A wok? (\textbf{\hi{कड़ाही}}, \emph{kaṛāhī}.) A rolling pin? (\textbf{\hi{बेलन}}, \emph{belan}.) A sieve? (\textbf{\hi{छलनी}}, \emph{chalnī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
